lane:
قلقس

قلقاس قُلْقَاسٌ [The _colocasia;_ or _arum. colocasia_ of Linnæus: or _its root:_] the _root of a certain plant, which is eaten cooked,_ (AHn, K,) _and used medicinally:_ (AHn:) _the decoction thereof increases the venereal faculty, and fattens; but the taking it constantly engenders black bile._ (AHn, K.) [See De Sacy's “ Relation de l'Egypte par Abd-allatif, ” pp. 94 — 98.]
